gbm_population_evidence.quote: Primary glioblastoma/astrocytoma WHO grade IV confirmed by 1)Magnetic Resonance Imaging according to RANO citera and 2)Frozen section biosy diagnosis

candidate_evidence.quote: [DEVICE] TRANBERG® laser applicators when used in MR-guided laser thermal ablation of brain lesions using the TRANBERG® Thermal Therapy System and TRANBERG® Thermoguide Workstation.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: considered not suitable for open surgery or other primary treatment, or Recurrent glioblastoma/astrocytoma WHO grade IV confirmed by Magnetic Resonance Imaging according to RANO criteria.

coder_notes: Device-only trial (laser interstitial thermal therapy); no drug or biologic interventions registered. Registry phase NA. Eligibility allows 'glioblastoma/astrocytoma WHO grade IV' without IDH requirement, coded historical terminology. Contrast agents for MRI/CT are routine imaging, not registered interventions, so not listed.
